mapper.select: select id, rel_requester_id, rel_receiver_id, rel_status, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_member_rel where (rel_requester_id = #{me} and rel_receiver_id = #{other}) or (rel_requester_id = #{other} and rel_receiver_id = #{me})
mapper.sql: m.id as member_id, m.member_alias as alias, (select '/api/files/' || max(fm.id) from tbl_file_member fm where fm.member_id = m.id) as avatar_url
mapper.select: select , to_char(r.updated_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') as since from tbl_member_rel r join tbl_member m on m.id = case when r.rel_requester_id = #{me} then r.rel_receiver_id else r.rel_requester_id end where (r.rel_requester_id = #{me} or r.rel_receiver_id = #{me}) and r.rel_status = 'done' and m.member_status = 'ACTIVE' order by m.member_alias

select , to_char(r.created_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') as since from tbl_member_rel r join tbl_member m on m.id = r.rel_requester_id where r.rel_receiver_id = #{me} and r.rel_status = 'pending' and m.member_status = 'ACTIVE' order by r.created_datetime desc

select , to_char(r.created_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') as since from tbl_member_rel r join tbl_member m on m.id = r.rel_receiver_id where r.rel_requester_id = #{me} and r.rel_status = 'pending' and m.member_status = 'ACTIVE' order by r.created_datetime desc
select count(*) from tbl_member_rel r join tbl_member m on m.id = r.rel_requester_id where r.rel_receiver_id = #{me} and r.rel_status = 'pending' and m.member_status = 'ACTIVE'

select , case when r.id is null then 'NONE' when r.rel_status = 'done' then 'FRIEND' when r.rel_requester_id = #{me} then 'REQUESTED' else 'RECEIVED' end as state from tbl_member m left join tbl_member_rel r on (r.rel_requester_id = #{me} and r.rel_receiver_id = m.id) or (r.rel_requester_id = m.id and r.rel_receiver_id = #{me}) where m.id <> #{me} and m.member_status = 'ACTIVE' and m.member_alias ilike #{pattern} order by (lower(m.member_alias) = lower(#{keyword})) desc, length(m.member_alias), m.member_alias limit #{limit}
